channel.title: Scaling Laws Devlog
channel.description: Build notes from Scaling Laws, an AI company tycoon by HCK Labs.

item.title: I Turned a Starter House Into the First AI Lab
item.description: Why Scaling Laws begins in a small house with one desk, a cheap car and a garage instead of dropping the player into a finished tech campus.

item.title: The Best GPU Can Still Be a Bad Purchase
item.description: Scaling Laws treats AI hardware as a dated asset: it loses value with time, gets hit again by successor generations and can bottleneck on the rest of the server.

item.title: Turning Chinchilla Scaling Laws Into a Game Mechanic
item.description: How Scaling Laws turns parameter count, training tokens and compute-optimal scaling into a readable tycoon decision instead of pretending its capability score is a real benchmark.
